classification.difficultyReason: Identify the radius from its square and sketch origin-centred circles with exact intercepts, including surds.

content.prompt: Sketch the graph of each circle, marking any intercepts.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}r^2&=25\\r&=5\end{align*}$$
The centre is $(0,0)$. Setting $y=0$ gives $x=\pm5$; setting $x=0$ gives $y=\pm5$. Draw a circle through these four intercepts.

spec.description: Unshaded circle centred at the origin, with arrowed axes and all four intercept values; source has no grid or separate tick marks.
